about: Layout audit findings known to be real and not yet fixed. In strict mode (SPOONJOY_REQUIRE_LAYOUT_AUDIT=1) any finding not listed here fails the capture. Task 10 fixed every entry, so the list is empty; a new entry needs an owner, a reason, and a fix before release. Each entry excuses one finding. Elements are accessibility identifiers, or label:<label> for an element without one.
